infoBadge.018ff480: It's a running total, so it never goes down. Taking a break won't cost you a level.
infoBadge.060f778c: Time the display was actually on. Time asleep or locked is excluded.
infoBadge.16b08d2b: Each track levels up from your running totals, and the next target keeps growing. There's no end, so there's always a next step.
infoBadge.176f76b7: The battery you used, converted using this Mac's actual capacity in watt-hours.
infoBadge.379e7d58: A number for fun. It runs high on days spent darting between things, and doesn't mean good or bad.
infoBadge.3ac264d8: Undo (Cmd+Z), redo, select-all, and backspaces as a share of all input, combined into 0–100. More undoing and deleting means a higher number.
infoBadge.487b65e7: You can change the threshold in Settings > Collection.
infoBadge.53e3ef50: 'Active time' only counts time with real input, so it's usually shorter. The gap between the two is time left running.
infoBadge.5bb0c341: Tags change day to day. They don't pin you to a type.
infoBadge.5f0c365d: macOS doesn't report power draw while plugged in, so only battery use is counted. Every conversion is approximate.
infoBadge.5f783ec6: Which sites you visited and what you sent is neither known nor stored. Only totals are counted.
infoBadge.6783ea14: Your style for the day comes from the ratio of key presses to pointer use (clicks plus scroll direction changes), and how much of it was shortcuts.
infoBadge.67ad806d: App switches per hour, visits shorter than 5 seconds, interrupted focus, and how much activity per minute jumped around, combined into 0–100.
infoBadge.894f8154: The sum of each app's share of time, squared — a Herfindahl index.
infoBadge.89e7602a: Neither the order you pressed keys nor the characters produced are stored. Only how many times each position was pressed.
infoBadge.9283801c: Total bytes across your network interfaces. Only the change in the system's own counters is read.
infoBadge.97ccf128: How concentrated your app time was, on a 0–100 scale. One app all day sits near 100; spread evenly across many, it drops.
infoBadge.bc617bb0: A stretch of continuous activity in one app past your threshold (5 minutes by default). Popping into another app for under 45 seconds doesn't break it, and it ends after 2 minutes without input.
infoBadge.c5e70d8c: A number for fun. It doesn't measure real regret or mistakes, and high isn't bad — it might just have been a day of heavy editing.
infoBadge.ccaddf17: Activity (30) + focus (30) + typing (20) + speed (20), out of 100. Each part rises more slowly as it approaches its reference value.
infoBadge.d5b39aee: A tally of how many times each key position was pressed. The more often, the redder.
infoBadge.dfcc74df: Not a productivity rating — just a summary of how busy today was. A low score is simply a quiet day.

settings.usageStats.detail: Sends "this install ran today", once a day, and nothing else. It carries the app version and your macOS version — never what you did or how much. No value that identifies your Mac goes out either: the identifier is a hash that changes daily, so two days' records cannot be joined together.
settings.usageStats.inactive: No endpoint set, so nothing is transmitted.
settingsRootView.08f28613: Only when a quest track levels up, at most %@ times a day. Personal bests are celebrated in the app without a notification — they're running totals, so you can pass several in one day.
